We also generate revenue from content licensing, Reddit Premium subscriptions, and products within our user economy. We recognize content licensing revenue as our content partners consume and benefit from their use of the licensed content, which is generally ratably over the license period. lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, approximately 94% and 91% of our revenue was generated from third parties advertising on our platform, respectively.

In addition, a substantial portion of our revenue is derived from a small number of advertisers, with our top ten largest advertisers accounting for approximately 21% and 25% of our revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
No customer accounted for greater than 10% of our revenues for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023.
No customer accounted for greater than 10% of our accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025 and 2024.
Advertisers of all sizes rely on Reddit to find highly engaged, high-intent customers in conversations that drive decisions at every stage of the path to purchase.

This is unique in the digital advertising marketplace; our lack of reliance on third-party data makes our offering more resilient to the loss of signal that other platforms rely upon as well as forthcoming changes to the internet ecosystem.
In an automated world that depends on human knowledge, we view Reddit as one of the most important and differentiated data sources.

Our success depends in part on our ability to protect our intellectual property and proprietary technologies, and we rely on intellectual property rights in the United States and other jurisdictions, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secret laws, license agreements, internal procedures, and contractual provisions.

• Our business depends on a strong brand and reputation, and if we are unable to maintain and enhance our brand and reputation, our ability to expand our user and advertiser bases will be impaired and our business, results of operations, financial condition, and prospects could be harmed.

• Redditor growth and engagement depends upon effective interoperation with operating systems, networks, devices, web browsers, online application stores, regulations, and standards that we do not control.

To the extent our DAUq growth rate slows or becomes negative, our success will increasingly depend on our ability to increase levels of engagement, retention, and monetization on our platform, including the level at which users visiting us from search traffic

We also rely on initiatives like machine translation to drive growth in international DAUq, and the growth derived from this strategy may slow as we complete the roll out of machine translation to all major global languages.
Our success depends on our ability to provide users of our products and services with valuable content, which in turn depends on the content contributed by Redditors.

In order to obtain new advertisers and further our relationship with current advertisers, we must increase the amount of monetizable content on our platform, including by increasing the absolute number of DAUq who post and consume content, and our monetization model depends on this engagement.

As we continue to grow our advertiser base, our revenue depends on our ability to effectively serve enough advertisements that meet the objectives of our advertisers while maintaining a high-quality, relevant, reliable, trustworthy, and innovative user experience.

Our business relies on an approach to content moderation that, while empowering community-led authenticity, can also result in content on the platform that can be unrelatable, offensive, and that may pose inherent risks.
Our business relies on a layered approach to content moderation.
Instead, we rely on our communities to self-organize and supplement our site-wide rules by devising their own rules that are tailored to the unique circumstances of their particular community.
We rely on an approach to content moderation that depends on Redditors who volunteer to be moderators of their communities.
Each community relies on one or more moderators who not only review content but also define and enforce community rules.
Our business relies on moderators to engage in good faith and to manage their subreddits in a manner that meets the needs of the subreddit’s members.
Our approach to content moderation depends on the activities of the moderators to protect the experiences
While we provide tools to our communities to manage their subreddits, our moderators also rely on their own and third-party tools.
Our ability to generate revenue depends on the development and availability of tools to accurately measure the effectiveness of advertisements on our platform.

Most advertisers rely on tools that measure the effectiveness of their ad campaigns or that verify viewability of their ads on our platform in order to allocate their advertising spend among various formats and platforms.

Developing and improving these tools may require significant time and resources and additional investment, and in some cases we rely on third parties to provide data and technology needed to provide certain measurements or other functions to our advertisers.

We rely on internal company data, assumptions, and estimates to calculate certain of our key metrics, and real or perceived inaccuracies in such current or historical metrics may harm our reputation and negatively affect our business.
In certain cases, we may need to rely on estimation techniques to improve the accuracy of such metrics.
The accuracy of these techniques will depend on the methodologies chosen, resulting in a metric that may not accurately reflect the monthly traffic to our platform.
In addition, our advertising partners rely on our metrics to inform ad spend.
Our business depends on attracting and retaining high-quality personnel in sales, services, engineering, marketing, finance, and support functions.
We depend on our senior management team and other key employees, and the loss of one or more of these employees could adversely affect our business.
Our business depends on continued and unimpeded access to our products and services on the internet by Redditors and our advertisers.
We depend on the ability of Redditors and our advertisers to access the internet.
